title: Local reconstruction of insulin electronic-correlation maps
difficulty_reasons: Requires constructing and validating 51 overlapping protein fragments, obtaining orbital-to-atomic/residue MI observables, and comparing locality-sensitive maps while preserving atom identity.

paper.title: Divide and correlate: mapping electronic correlations in proteins via local cut-wise reconstruction

data.description: Self-contained original experimental PDB 3I40 and system, contact, MI-definition and comparison-radius specification.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable calculation, validation, optional comparison and scientific conclusion report.
